evidence.quote: I see the balance of risks in the economy as having shifted in recent months with increased downside risks to employment compared to the upside risks to inflation, which have likely declined somewhat recently.
The evolving balance of risks underscores the need to proceed slowly as we approach the neutral rate.
A reasonable base case is that tariffs result in a one-time shift in the price level, not an ongoing inflation problem.
While still solid, I continue to view the risk to my employment forecast as skewed to the downside.
I also supported the decision to conclude the reduction of our aggregate securities holdings as of December 1.
indicating that progress toward our 2 percent target has stalled.
